main_text.p: II. Christum Verum Hominem credit & profitetur Christianus, quia dicitur Semen mulieris. Genes. 3. vers. 15. Semen Abrahæ, in quo benedicendæ sint omnes gentes. Genes. 22. vers. 18. Filius Davidis, qui sedere debeat super eius solio, & regnare in perpetuum, 2. Sam. 7. v. 12. & 16. Virginis filius, Ies. 7. v. 14. Secundo ut verum hominem. Propter testimonia Scripturæ. Deinde tota historia Evangelica demonstrat Christum hunc, conceptum, natum, circumcisum, habuisse corpus verum, & animam, esurivisse, sitivisse, effudisse sanguinem, mortuum esse, omnes q; proprietates & affectiones naturæ humanæ (sed absq; peccato) habuisse, &c. Ex proprietates & opera humana natura.
Credit autem Christianus huc Servatorem oportuisse hominem esse. In hunc finem.

1. Quia justitia id requirebat, ut inobedientia in carne nostra commissa, in eadem sarciretur, in Epist. ad Romanos c. 5. v. 17. 18. 19. Heb. 2. v. 14. 2. Postulabat hoc adoptionis nostri ratio. Voluit enim Filius Dei Naturam huma- 1. Ut satisfieret iustitia. 2. Ut frater noster esset & nos filii Dei.

page.notes: Right margin notes are read from the scan; the mid-text note marks are not visible as letters. The left edge carries show-through from the facing page, which was omitted. The top-right ornament is not transcribed. Reading of the small italic marginal notes is partly uncertain; "Ex proprietates & opera humana natura." and the verse references are the least certain.
